The reasoning posits that although Mary possesses complete physical knowledge regarding color vision while isolated in a black-and-white room, she acquires new non-physical knowledge upon experiencing color for the first time after her release. This distinction between physical and phenomenal concepts supports the conclusion that not all information is physical.
